study.title: WeedVision: A single-stage deep learning architecture to perform weed detection and segmentation using drone-acquired images
study.short_title: WeedVision YOLO-style single-stage weed instance seg (AGX Xavier)

models_tested: WeedVision (YOLO-inspired single-stage; C3/C3x modules + ProtoNet mask head) (proposed)
segmentation.best_model: WeedVision trained on C4 augmentation set: mask precision 0.828 (RTX 3060), 0.77 on AGX Xavier

dataset.name: NDSU weed dataset (greenhouse + in-field: ASF Casselton & CREC Carrington, ND)
dataset.note: Images 2021-2022 (mid-May to late Sept): Canon 90D handheld (6960x4640) + DJI Phantom 4 Pro V2.0 in-field (5472x3648 @ ~12 ft / 3.7 m); clipped/resized to 640x640; Roboflow annotation (polygon) -> 7,192 masks (kochia 1,786, ragweed 3,086, horseweed 2,320); 5 augmentation categories C1-C5 (C4 = 2,257 training images, shear/blur/noise/cutout/bbox-flip/bbox-rotation; recommendation), ~291 val and ~291 test images.

segmentation.backbone: YOLO-style CNN 23-layer with C3 (depthwise+dilated) and C3x modules, SPPF, ProtoNet (32 prototype masks, SiLU) head

mIoU.ambiguity: Instance-segmentation study evaluated by precision/recall/mAP(@0.5) for bounding boxes and masks; no semantic segmentation metric reported.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Per-species-wise F1 not reported. Mask precision (C4 GPU): 0.828 (Pm), mask recall 0.437; edge (AGX Xavier): mask precision 0.77, recall 0.51. mAPm(@.5): C4 0.605 GPU / 0.636 edge (TorchScript).

edge.framework: PyTorch -> TorchScript / ONNX (edge: AGX Xavier, 8-core Carmel ARM CPU, 512-core Volta GPU + 64 Tensor Cores, 32 GB RAM, 32 TOPS)

fps.ambiguity: Not reported; per-frame latency 2.1-2.3 ms implies ~440-475 fps (derived).

latency_ms.quote: The inference speed of the architecture was 2.1 ms and 2.3 ms per image for C4 and C5 category, respectively (TorchScript on Jetson AGX Xavier); ONNX ~1.25X faster
latency_ms.section: 3.3 Assessing the best format for edge deployment
latency_ms.ambiguity: EDGE deployment on Jetson AGX Xavier (per 640x640 image). C4 2.1 ms, C5 2.3 ms (TorchScript); ONNX ~1.25x faster. Desktop (RTX 3060) inference timing 87.2 ms (C4) for reference. Metrics on edge: TorchScript C4 mask precision 0.77, mAPm@.5 0.636.

gflops.ambiguity: C3x integration discussed to avoid increased FLOPs; no numeric FLOPs reported.

issues: Instance-segmentation study: primary metrics precision/recall/mAP(@0.5) for bbox and masking; no semantic segmentation quality metric -> RQ1 not reportable.
Minor inconsistency: text states C5 masking mAP 60.5% (Table 3 shows 61.1%).
Edge deployment on AGX Xavier confirmed (TorchScript/ONNX) with per-image latency; power not measured.
Dataset mixes greenhouse/handheld + field/UAV images (drone at ~3.7 m); test set mainly in-field.
